versions.line: A button in the panel, such as What's new or Close in the update note, works on the first click
The README, the guide, the privacy page and claudopus.ai now describe Claudopus as it is today
Stats no longer fails with "Svg source longer than 131072 characters" once there is a lot of history
Your reply reaches work at once even while it runs something long
In the desktop app a card's answers now end with "Reply in your own words"
Everything Claudopus says about updating now says only which version your chats run, which is the newest
claudopus.ai is now built only from main, not from every branch pushed
The Keys button beside Memory is gone
Typing in a reply box no longer pulls the panel back down
A press on Allow once, Always allow, Deny or an ask's buttons shows its answer at once
After Update (or Install) there is no Reload button
In the desktop app, a figure's card above the prompt now floats over the chat, just above its figure
A chat that runs Claudopus's own code now updates with one press, Update, then Reload
Work that finishes comes to the top of the panel at once, right under anything that waits for you
Work is told to add a test only when no test already covers what it changes
The panel and Details are no longer rebuilt every second while work runs
A release now waits for GitHub's own checks on the exact version it is about to put out
A newer Claudopus is now a small grey box in the panel's header, not a big notice
The battery card now shows what the whole Mac draws, what the processors and the graphics processor each draw
After you answer an ask on its card (a button such as Release it or Done, or a reply from its box)
A Stop you press on a card, or on a helper under it, now holds
In the desktop app, resting the pointer on a figure above the prompt now really shows its card, one at a time
Claudopus now remembers which keys, tokens and logins you have given, by name and where each is kept
Under a card, only runs that are really running are listed
While you type into an ask's reply box or a key box, the panel and Details hold still
The battery above the prompt no longer shows a time to full beside 100%
Everything that waits for your press is at the top of the panel, right under its header, the newest first
A run's second line starts under its name, with the tree's line carried down beside it
The line above the prompt now shows the battery
Work and helpers start only on the newest models
